content:
If you like the new wallpapers Apple designed for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, you don't need to buy a new iPhone to use them—you can download them right here now.

Download the brand-new iPhone 18 Pro wallpapers

Although the default iOS wallpapers display dynamically and respond to the device's movement and gestures, below are static images captured directly from the first iOS 27 candidate build.

The candidate build does not appear to include the iPhone Duo wallpaper, so you may have to wait a few more weeks, perhaps until iOS 27.1.

Remember to tap the image to download the full-resolution wallpaper, then set it as your background via the Photos app or the Settings app (if you're using an iOS device).

For 9to5Mac's full coverage of Apple's "Surprise and Shine" event, click here.
